label: pjm 83 srmc reground
definition: KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-06, replacing pjm-77; L-13 lane). Two grounded structural changes on the pjm-77 recipe: (1) G-21 SRMC re-grounding — the two sub-SRMC residual offer artifacts ST_GAS (committed/econ_low/econ_high 0.4752/0.6552/0.90) and CT_INTERMEDIATE (committed/econ_low 0.9/0.92) move to the Manual-15 composite-cost floor 1.00x. Correct offer physics (rule 1: a non-CHP steam/CT unit's part-load IHR exceeds full-load, so no tranche may clear below 1.0x AHR x delivered fuel — the floor CC_REGULAR already carries); a sub-SRMC offer is not real and is NOT kept just because it flattered gas volume. (2) CT_CHP EMAAC/Central_PA reliability tmax limbs scrubbed — all-24h flat floors binding 70.8% off-window (the deciding pjm-77 D-4 failure, 0.0052/0.0095/0.009 TWh); the class's hot-day lift is an all-hours steam-host intensification owned by chp_steam (rule 19). Scrub locked by tests/test_reliability_floor.py::TestPjmCtChpScrubLocked (rule 26). The ct_netload_drag window [15,22) is UNCHANGED: the L-13 overnight-reliability evidence check (diag_pjm_ct_overnight_evidence.py; docs/handoffs/pjm-ct-overnight-evidence-2026-07.md) confirmed overnight CT CF is a flat ~2% net-load-insensitive economic baseline (not reliability) plus a small extreme-net-load uptick 3-5x weaker than the ramp relationship — widening the hinge overnight would over-floor 2-3x; the extreme-net-load overnight duty is owned by reserve/ORDC (G-20 Phase 2, memory-gated). PROMOTED ON STRUCTURE (rule 1: keeper = most structurally faithful, not lowest MAE). Legitimacy improves vs pjm-77: D-4 CT_CHP failure RESOLVED (only residual is reliability_floor x CT_PEAKER 0.0002 TWh in 2023, a mixed-fuel-plant class-aggregation artifact — solve floors carry ZERO CT_PEAKER reliability, the drag owns the class and is 0% off-window); D-2 PASS at rubric v2.1 (CT_PEAKER 9.2/14.5/10.2% < 15% peaker budget). Determination NOT-YET (same class as pjm-77). DISCLOSED CALIBRATION TRADEOFF (rule 14, tracked as issue #1483, NOT a reason to revert): de-flooding ST_GAS relocates ~14 TWh/yr — 2023 CC_REGULAR IMPROVES (-19.8 to -9.9 TWh) but 2024 CC over-runs (+13.5 TWh) and 2025 coal +6.2% (a new C2 sysvol FAIL vs pjm-77); real ST_GAS runs far more than a pure-efficiency merit order clears, an unmodeled RMR/local-deliverability driver. Price mean/tail and CT under-dispatch unchanged (the memory-blocked per-gen reserve/ORDC item, G-20 Phase 2). Zero-forcing ablation twin registered (2026-07-06-pjm-83-reground-ablation): all merchant floors to 0, CT_PEAKER total barely moves (drag does timing/shape, not net volume). See docs/calibration-log.md and docs/handoffs/pjm-ct-overnight-evidence-2026-07.md.
